polaris: LP29-C2T-S2 / context baseline vs reproduced Srivastava exact O_s baseline

framework.name: proof-carrying execution / reproducible-build attestation
framework.analogy: Treat a reported OI_norm like a binary checksum printed in a paper: useful context, but not a reproducible build unless the source, build rule, dependency versions, input artifact identity, and generated intermediate hashes are carried with it.
framework.discipline_source: computer science: proof-carrying code, software supply-chain attestation, and executable test oracles
framework.scope_limit: This framework defines reproduction evidence for exact O_s only. It does not perform material validation and does not claim Srivastava O_s has been reproduced.

math_object.definition: A finite certificate C that makes O_s an executable function of a declared source row, structure, pair-selection rule, raw overlap computation, and normalization map.

typed_contract.source_row_id: stable DOI/table/figure/SI/path plus row or sample identifier
typed_contract.structure_id: exact atomistic structure or declared reconstruction version used for the computation
typed_contract.pair_rule: pair cutoff in Angstrom or exact source-defined pair-selection procedure
typed_contract.raw_overlap_sum: numeric pre-normalization sum over the declared pair set
typed_contract.normalization_map: auditable equation or code path mapping raw_overlap_sum to OI_norm or O_s
typed_contract.same_structure_crosswalk: proof that reported context, raw sum, denominator, and normalized value refer to the same structure_id
typed_contract.executor_trace: machine-reviewable record proving the declared inputs recompute the declared output within tolerance

math_object.minimal_equation_form: O_s = N(S, P, theta_norm)[ sum_{(i,j) in P(S, theta_pair)} omega(i,j; theta_formula) ]
math_object.invariant: Changing source_row_id, structure_id, pair rule, raw sum, or normalization creates a different certificate, even if the final reported OI_norm number is identical.

findings.finding: Reported OI_norm is a context datum, not a residual-validation baseline, unless it is attached to a reproduction certificate that exposes the raw sum and normalization path.
basis: C2T gate G5 blocks Srivastava-style OI reproduction when exact formula/code, normalization rule, or same-structure mapping is missing.
Round 4 A-side witness requirements make OI_raw_sum, OI_normalization_formula_id, pair_cutoff_A, pair_density, source_row_id, and structure_id required fields.

findings.finding: The shortest B-side falsifier is not a better physical model; it is a replay executor that either recomputes the exact value or emits a typed blocker.
basis: The witness schema states schema conformance is not material validation.
The executor contract derives row decisions from payload fields and ignores manual labels.

findings.finding: A Srivastava row can pass as context and still fail as reproduced O_s. The two statuses must be represented as separate modes.
basis: OI_comparison_mode must distinguish no_claim, fixed_density, fixed_pair, and srivastava_reproduction.
Reported OI_norm without raw-sum derivation remains not reproduced under the listed witness requirements.

strangest_prediction.prediction: If Srivastava exact O_s is truly reproducible from public materials, the first successful payload will look less like a citation table and more like a software build receipt: the raw overlap sum and normalization rule will force a unique pair-count/cutoff lineage, and most ambiguous reported rows will collapse into BLOCK before any material comparison is attempted.
strangest_prediction.observable: A machine executor should be able to flip at least one row from BLOCK to PASS only by adding formula/code, raw sum, normalization, pair cutoff, and same-structure mapping witnesses; adding prose context alone should leave G5 as BLOCK or WARN.
strangest_prediction.falsifier: If a reported OI_norm row can pass G5 without raw overlap sum, normalization id, and structure crosswalk, then the gate predicates are internally inconsistent and must be revised before residual validation.

a_objection.likely_objection: A may argue that Srivastava 2019 already reports OI_norm and effective-mass context, so requiring raw sums and executable witnesses is an unnecessary audit burden.
a_objection.b_reply: That objection changes the claim type. Reported OI_norm can support literature context, but residual validation requires an independently replayable baseline. The burden is not extra physics; it is the minimum needed to prevent a context number from being silently reused as an exact O_s oracle.

failed_jumps.attempt: Treat reported OI_norm as a prior mean and validate residuals against posterior uncertainty.
failed_jumps.failure_reason: This would soften the exact-reproduction problem into uncertainty modeling and would not identify whether the same structure, pair cutoff, and normalization were used.

failed_jumps.attempt: Use same graph identity as a surrogate for same O_s structure mapping.
failed_jumps.failure_reason: Graph identity does not prove orbital-overlap computation identity; it can share topology while losing orbital formula, raw pair weights, or normalization.

failed_jumps.attempt: Accept a published normalized value as a calibrated reference standard.
failed_jumps.failure_reason: A metrology standard still needs traceability. Without raw sum, denominator, and procedure provenance, the normalized value is not traceable enough for replay.

next_plan.round2_direction: Build a negative-control executor table for Srivastava-style rows: each row should emit a deterministic blocker code for the first missing proof-carrying field.
immediate_artifacts: S2_Srivastava_reproduction_blocker_table with blocker codes for source_row_id, structure_id, OI_raw_sum, OI_normalization_formula_id, pair_cutoff_A, pair_density, N_pair, and same_structure_mapping
Draft O_s certificate JSON instance with all fields null or missing where public evidence is absent, explicitly yielding BLOCK
A mode-separation rule preventing reported_context_only from being promoted to srivastava_reproduction
next_plan.stop_condition: Stop before material validation. Only proceed when at least one row has machine-reviewable witnesses for exact formula/code, raw sum, normalization, pair selection, and same-structure mapping.

claims.statement: For LP29-C2T-S2, a reported Srivastava OI_norm value is insufficient as a residual-validation baseline unless the exact O_s reproduction certificate is present.
equations: O_s = N(S, P, theta_norm)[ sum_{(i,j) in P(S, theta_pair)} omega(i,j; theta_formula) ]
assumptions: Residual validation requires a replayable numerical baseline, not only a reported literature context value.
Machine-reviewable witness payloads are the governing standard for C2T gating.
No material validation is permitted during this reproduction-gate task.

claims.statement: The primary failure mode should be typed as missing reproduction witness rather than physical disagreement.
equations: decision = BLOCK if applies_to_row=true and (formula_or_code=null or normalization_rule=null or same_structure_mapping=null or raw_sum=null or pair_rule=null)
assumptions: G5 is applicable to rows claiming Srivastava-style OI baseline comparison.
Manual pass/fail labels are advisory and must be recomputed from witness fields.

reproduction_payload_minimum.payload_name: Srivastava exact O_s reproduction certificate minimum
not_claimed: Srivastava exact O_s has been reproduced
any material-level residual validation is allowed

required_fields.why_required: Identifies the exact Srivastava/OI source row used by the witness payload.
required_fields.pass_witness: Stable DOI plus table/figure/SI/path plus row/sample/snapshot id.
required_fields.blocker_if_missing: Cannot know which reported OI_norm or structure is being replayed.

required_fields.why_required: Binds the overlap computation to the exact atomistic structure or reconstruction version.
required_fields.pass_witness: Raw structure file, SI structure, or declared reconstruction manifest tied to source_row_id.
required_fields.blocker_if_missing: Reported context may refer to a different structure than the replayed computation.

required_fields.why_required: Prevents reported_context_only from being promoted into srivastava_reproduction.
required_fields.pass_witness: Predeclared enum: no_claim, fixed_density, fixed_pair, or srivastava_reproduction.
required_fields.blocker_if_missing: Executor cannot determine whether G5 applies.

required_fields.why_required: Defines omega(i,j) and the summation procedure for exact O_s.
required_fields.pass_witness: Equation id, SI method, or versioned code reference that is machine-reviewable.
required_fields.blocker_if_missing: Raw and normalized values cannot be independently recomputed.

required_fields.why_required: Separates the measured or computed overlap sum from normalization and reporting.
required_fields.pass_witness: Numeric raw overlap sum with source_row_id, structure_id, pair rule, and computation provenance.
required_fields.blocker_if_missing: Reported OI_norm remains context only, even if the number is present.

required_fields.why_required: Defines the map from OI_raw_sum to OI_norm or exact O_s.
required_fields.pass_witness: Auditable equation, SI table note, or code path tied to the same source row.
required_fields.blocker_if_missing: Different normalizations can yield incomparable baselines.

required_fields.why_required: Defines the pair set P(S, theta_pair) used in the raw sum.
required_fields.pass_witness: Numeric cutoff in Angstrom or source-defined pair-selection procedure id.

required_fields.why_required: Needed when comparing under fixed_density mode and to audit denominator consistency.
required_fields.pass_witness: Numeric pair density with units, derived from the same structure and pair rule.

required_fields.why_required: Needed when comparing under fixed_pair mode and for raw-sum denominator checks.
required_fields.pass_witness: Positive integer counted from the same structure and pair rule.
required_fields.blocker_if_missing: Pair-mean or fixed-pair normalization cannot be audited.

required_fields.why_required: Proves that N_pair came from the same source row, structure, and pair rule.
required_fields.pass_witness: Versioned count manifest, SI count table, or executable pair-count trace.
required_fields.blocker_if_missing: A numeric denominator is not traceable.

required_fields.why_required: Binds reported OI_norm, raw sum, pair denominator, and formula execution to one structure identity.
required_fields.pass_witness: Crosswalk record linking source_row_id, structure_id, snapshot/window, and any reconstruction version.
required_fields.blocker_if_missing: The executor cannot exclude cross-structure leakage.

required_fields.why_required: Makes the certificate proof-carrying rather than prose-only.
required_fields.pass_witness: Machine-reviewable replay log with input hashes, formula/code version, computed raw sum, normalization, tolerance, and final O_s.
required_fields.blocker_if_missing: The payload cannot be independently replayed.

derived_failure_paths.rationale: The overlap weight and summation semantics are undefined.

derived_failure_paths.condition: OI_raw_sum is missing while OI_norm is present
derived_failure_paths.decision: BLOCK for reproduction; context-only may remain available
derived_failure_paths.rationale: The normalized report cannot be decomposed or replayed.
Raw and normalized overlap cannot be connected.

derived_failure_paths.condition: pair_cutoff_A and exact pair-selection procedure are both missing
witnesses are prose-only or not machine_reviewable
derived_failure_paths.decision: WARN or BLOCK depending on required field status
derived_failure_paths.rationale: Manual interpretation cannot substitute for executable evidence.
This stage is reproduction gating only.

reproduction_payload_minimum.minimal_pass_rule: PASS for Srivastava reproduction requires OI_comparison_mode=srivastava_reproduction, material_validation_claimed=false, non-null source_row_id, structure_id, exact_overlap_formula_or_code_ref, OI_raw_sum, OI_normalization_formula_id, pair_cutoff_A or exact pair procedure, same_structure_mapping_ref, and machine-reviewable witnesses sufficient to replay O_s.
reproduction_payload_minimum.context_only_rule: A row with reported OI_norm but without raw sum, normalization, pair rule, and same-structure crosswalk must be labeled reported_context_only or no_claim for reproduction; it cannot serve as a residual-validation baseline.
